[b]Office of the Secretary General[/b]

[u]Regarding Valdderan Involvement in the Tirakan Civil War and Suspension [/u]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم[/i]

The EOIC continues to condemn the Valdderan military involvement in the Tirakan Civil War on the basis of Article II of the Constitution. If any member state of the EOIC were to do what Valddera has done, they would also be suspended. As such, any accusation of this being unfair is baseless and asinine. Regardless, we also emphasize that the PRV is the only legitimate government of Valddera and once again call on the ISV and Democratic Valddera to enter into negotiations with the PRV to end that conflict peacefully, in shaa Allah. We call upon all factions in Tirakan to seek peace and reconciliation, and to remember that the lives of the Tirakan people are far more valuable than power and wealth. May Allah swt give victory to those who will establish justice, stability, and ethical governance there.

[i]Abdullah al-Barazakh
Secretary General of the EOIC[/i]

[b]An idea, and beyond..[/b]
[sub]Order, Justice, Unity.[/sub]]

[b]Pan-Shamatism[/b]

[i]1976, West and East Shamat[/i]

[i](based upon the irl ideology of Pan-Eurasianism, but different ;)[/i]

[b]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

As many of yall know, Shamat is the combined continents of East, and West Shamat.

Although differences are present, people from Shamat always have had a feeling of a bond with each other, especially compared to their connections with other continents. Neo-Colonialism is still present at all current times, and people usually don't like those nations being present on their continents, some exceptions are very much present, but there will always be a feeling of external influences.

50 years ago, something ignited, something started, in a lot of forms and identities, but it was still unknown, [i]sadly[/i]. Many forms and versions existed, you can call them what you want; left, right, progressive, conservative, extreme, centrist and beyond. Even people from Shamat, who were outside Shamat, felt a connection to this idea, to this concept.

It grew and it grew, at some point every single person in a city would know about it. The Idea of Shamatism and/or Pan-Shamatism. BUT, the problem was, no one was truly expressing it yet, and no one truly saw it as something doable. Until one certain day in the Sikirskian province of Zirsk, to be precise, in the now-very-important city of [b]Kerlgrad:[/b]

[b]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[/b]

[b]A Congress![/b]

Good Evening gentlemen and gentlewomen of Shamat! I, Volodymyr Uladzimir, welcome you to the first Pan-Shamatist Congress of [i]1984[/i]

Our idea has grown and expanded a lot, this congress was something we have been waiting for too long already! Shamat and its people have been waiting too long for this...

I have recently founded the Sikirskian Pan-Shamatist Salvation Party, and as planned it has grown to a national scale. I see many of you here, from the Far East, to the Far West.

We may not be [b]there[/b] yet, but do not falter. It will only get better from now on.

[i][b] "What is a United Shamat?"[/b][/i]

[i]--The room erupts into clapping and cheering.--[/i]

[b]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[/b]

[b]Define; Modern Day Chaos[/b]

Welcome to the evening broadcast, citizens of the Federatsiya. As lately revealed, the [b]CTO+[/b] Coalition government has fallen. Marshal-Prezident Mitarski has announced that he is aware of the current situation. The situations outcome is unknown. Mass protests have spiraled out of control, major cities with this situation include; Grand Yugorsk, New & Old Liberatska City, [b]Kerlgrad[/b], and Likastad. Besides that, we have just received new estimate poll results, SPSSP has had a once again major increase in popularity, 49,7%, CTO, 29,2%, RCS: 12,9%, NPA: 7,0%, RAU: 0,9%. We keep you updated whenever possible, [i]Drobyden, good night.[/i]

[i]What could ever go wrong? :)[/i]

[b][u]__END OF MESSAGE__[/u][/b]

[/spoiler]
